capabilities: suggest or apply a tag to the currently open note via a command or ribbon icon
choose the tag from the vault's most-used existing tags with a None option
add the tag to frontmatter tags or append an inline #tag
show the chosen tag and the model's confidence in a notification
dry-run suggestions without writing to the note
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README details exactly what data is sent to TypeSafe and states there are no background network calls or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pick a fitting tag for a note automatically from the vault's existing tag vocabulary.
summary: AI tagger that suggests or applies one tag to the current note using TypeSafe's Jev model and the vault's most-used tags.
